Soil Type & Bioreactor Deployment: Taiwan Townships

Click any township to see its dominant soil texture and the corresponding bioreactor density from the FVM coverage model. Filter by county, or view the whole country at once.

358 townships mapped 20 counties & cities Real MOI boundaries
Data status: Township boundaries are real (MOI 鄉鎮市區界線, via the open-source taiwan-atlas / g0v dataset). Soil-type assignments are a first-pass illustrative national classification based on general Taiwan geomorphology (coastal / plain / piedmont-mountain / tableland / basin patterns), not yet cross-checked against a verified soil-texture survey table. Kinmen and Matsu (offshore, non-contiguous) are excluded from this map.
